{{Short description|French statistician (1824–1907)}}
[[File:Résumé_graphique_général_de_l'Atlas_statistique_de_la_population_de_Paris.jpg|thumb|upright=1.5|General graphic summary of the Statistical Atlas of the population of Paris. It is one of the first graphical representation of data in the form of a [[heat map]].<ref name=dataviz>{{Cite web |title=Milestones in the History of Thematic Cartography, Statistical Graphics, and Data Visualization |url=https://www.datavis.ca/milestones/index.php?group=1850+&mid=ms143%C3%93 |access-date=2022-12-26 |website=www.datavis.ca}}</ref>]]
'''Toussaint Loua''' (1824 – 1907) was a French statistician and was credited for inventing the [[heat map]] in information visualization.<ref name=dataviz /><ref name=pop>{{Cite journal |title=Classifying Individuals by Their Participation in the Production System: The 'Active' and 'Inactive' Populations in Late 19th-Century France |journal=Population |date=24 June 2022 |volume=77 |issue=1 |pages=113–136 |url=https://www.cairn-int.info/journal-population-2022-1-page-113.htm |last1=Hirsch |first1=Agnès |last2=Reeve |first2=Paul }}</ref>

== Career ==
Loua was born in Saarn in modern day Germany.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Toussaint Loua (1824-1907) |url=https://data.bnf.fr/13487353/toussaint_loua/ |access-date=2022-12-26 |website=data.bnf.fr |language=en}}</ref>

He began his career as a clerk at the [[Ministry of Commerce]] in 1850 at the age of 26. From 1875 to 1887, Loua directed the General Directorate of Statistics of France (French: ''Statistique générale de la France''). Under his direction, the SGF published in 1878 the first Statistical Yearbook of France (French: ''Annuaire statistique de la France'') and it was also under its mandate that in 1885 the High Council of Statistics was created.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Découpage du territoire français : Troisième république (1875-1918) |url=http://projetbabel.org/gl/cog49c.htm |access-date=2022-12-26 |website=projetbabel.org}}</ref><ref name=pop />

* 1865 : ''Mémoire sur quelques questions de statistique''

* 1873 : ''Atlas statistique de la population de Paris'', J. Dejey (Paris), [https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k81402n Version digitale]

* 1877 : « Le Divorce en Belgique », ''Journal de la société de statistique de Paris'', vol. 18, pages 155-158, [http://eudml.org/doc/240129 url]
* 1879 : ''Les Logements insalubres à Paris'', Berger-Levrault (Paris)
* 1885 : ''Les Déplacements de la population en France'', Berger-Levrault (Paris)
* {{Cite journal |last=Loua |first=M. Toussaint |date=1886 |title=Statistical Review of the Present Position of Italy |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2979298 |journal=Journal of the Statistical Society of London |volume=49 |issue=3 |pages=662–672 |jstor=2979298 |issn=0959-5341}}
* 1888 : ''La France sociale et économique d'après les documents officiels les plus récents'', Paris : Berger-Levrault
* 1889 : « À propos de l'exposition universelle de 1889 », ''Journal de la société de statistique de Paris'', vol. 30, pages 325-330, [http://eudml.org/doc/243424 url]
